summary: --- name: core-overview description: arch-tsdown-monorepo purpose, structure, and when to use it --- # arch-tsdown-monorepo Overview arch-tsdown-monorepo is a **pnpm monorepo** starter for TypeScript libraries, based on [hairyf/starter-monorepo](https://github.com/hairyf/starter-monorepo). Each package uses **tsdown** for building. Use this skill when scaffolding or maintaining a multi-package TypeScript/ESM library with shared tooling and workspace dependencies. ## What It Is - A **monorepo starter** for publishing multiple TypeScript packages from one repo - Build: **tsdown** per package (same pattern as arch-tsdown) - Workspace: **pnpm** with `packages/*`, **catalogs** for shared devDependency versions
